meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让关键计划在敲定前先经受多方挑刺与交叉质疑,变得更扎实
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你制定关键计划时希望有人从对立角度帮你查漏补缺,而不是只收获附和。
copy.tagline_en: Toughen up your plan by running it past a hostile review team before you commit.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own important plans and want them to survive hostile scrutiny before being locked in.

howto.what: Claude 会先宣告“HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”,然后作为主持人组织 5 个互相敌对的评审角色轮番攻击方案,只保留经得住批驳的结论,最后交给专门的规划器产出正式计划。
howto.when: 当用户要求做 hyperplan、对抗式或交叉评审式规划,或表示需要最严格规划时触发。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 评审一下这个重构计划。
say.note: Claude 会宣告模式已启用,再组织对抗评审。

say.text: 对我的发布方案做对抗式交叉评审。
say.note: 五个敌对角色会轮番攻击方案,只留反驳不倒的结论。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 模式规划这个功能的上线步骤。
say.note: 适合要求规划必须格外严谨的场合。

howto.what_en: Claude announces “HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”, then hosts five mutually hostile reviewers who attack the plan in rounds. Only findings that survive are distilled and handed to a dedicated planner, which writes the final plan.
howto.when_en: When the user asks for a hyperplan, an adversarial/cross-critique plan, or when planning needs maximum rigor.

say_en.text: Run a hyperplan review on this refactoring plan.
say_en.note: Claude announces mode, then runs the adversarial review.

say_en.text: Do an adversarial cross-critique of my launch plan.
say_en.note: Five hostile roles attack it; only surviving points remain.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan mode to plan this feature rollout.
say_en.note: Use when you need especially rigorous planning.
